أستضعف (form X)
# أَسْتَضْعِفُ (ʔastaḍʕifu) /ʔas.tadˤ.ʕi.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَضْعَفَ (istaḍʕafa)
# أُسْتَضْعَفُ (ʔustaḍʕafu) /ʔus.tadˤ.ʕa.fu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَضْعَفَ (istaḍʕafa)
# أَسْتَضْعِفَ (ʔastaḍʕifa) /ʔas.tadˤ.ʕi.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَضْعَفَ (istaḍʕafa)
# أُسْتَضْعَف
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
